item.title: John Woods Sees AI Selloff as Positioning-Driven
item.description: John Woods says the sharp pullback in AI-exposed stocks is a positioning-driven correction rather than a sign of deteriorating market fundamentals. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Japan’s Nikkei Poised to Enter Bear Market as AI Selloff Deepens
item.description: Japan’s Nikkei 225 Stock Average slumped Friday, putting the tech-heavy gauge on course to enter a technical bear market as investors unwind artificial intelligence-related trades.

item.title: Mystery Seller Puts Up $500 Million Data Center Loans Backing Stargate, CyrusOne
item.description: Dutch bank ING is putting up for sale a roughly $500 million portfolio of data center loans all at once, according to people familiar with the matter. The rare auction comes just days after a Democratic sweep of the US midterm elections raised doubts about the future of many of the projects.

item.title: Japan Bonds Rally as Global Risk-Off Move Boosts Haven Demand
item.description: Japanese government bonds rose on Friday, tracking a rally in Treasuries, as a US stock selloff spilled into Asian markets and deepened a broader risk-off move.
